Overview of OSSSC Recruitment 2026

The Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC) has issued an indicative notice for the recruitment of 238 Ophthalmic Officer positions. These roles are categorized under District Cadre Group-C posts within the Health & Family Welfare Department of the Government of Odisha.

Recruitment Details

  • Organization: Odisha Sub-Ordinate Staff Selection Commission (OSSSC)
  • Total Vacancies: 238 posts
  • Job Category: District Cadre Group-C
  • Location: Odisha
  • Official Website: osssc.gov.in

Important Dates

Interested candidates should take note of the following schedule for the online application process:

  • Application Commencement: November 5, 2026
  • Application Closing Date: December 5, 2026

Application Process

Candidates are advised to monitor the official OSSSC portal for the release of the detailed recruitment notification, which will outline specific eligibility criteria and selection procedures. To apply once the process commences, applicants may follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official website at osssc.gov.in.
  2. Locate and click the recruitment link for the Ophthalmic Officer position.
  3. Enter the required registration details.
  4. Submit the completed application form.
  5. Upload all necessary documentation.
  6. Retain a printed copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Status of Information

This report is based on an indicative notice released by the OSSSC. While the organization has confirmed the total number of vacancies and the application timeline, further details regarding age limits, selection stages, and examination fees are expected to be included in the forthcoming detailed PDF notification. Candidates should verify all final requirements directly on the official commission website before submitting their applications.
